worldcombat.skill.firefang.summary: A close short bite that presses a flame into the wound: the bite deals damage and may set the target burning; the burn follows native immunity, so a fire-type or immune body will not catch it and the fire only scatters off the surface. A hard bite can also leave the target flinching. Searing style lights easier and burns longer; quick-bite style hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.use.0: Bite and set a nearby target burning at close range
worldcombat.skill.firefang.use.1: Light a nearby foe with the shortest bite
worldcombat.skill.firefang.use.2: Wince the target and cut off what it is doing
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.0: A short bite along your aim; the first body or wall it meets is the contact: biting a non-friendly deals about %1$s contact and bite damage over a fang radius of %2$s blocks, with defence, type matchup and crits settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.1: A hit has a %1$s chance to press the flame into the wound, burning for %2$s; while burning, the target loses about 1/16 of its max health (at least 1) every 5 seconds and deals half physical damage.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.2: The burn follows native immunity: a fire-type or immune-ability body will not catch, and the fire only bursts on the surface and dies out, never piercing.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.3: A hit has a %1$s chance to make the target flinch for %2$s, interrupting an interruptible action; while flinching it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.sear.on: Searing style: easier and longer burns, but a lighter bite and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.sear.off: Quick-bite style: a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but the flame is harder to catch.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s and the burn chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.preference.se: On: burn chance +12%%, burn duration x1.2, but bite power x0.90, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks, better at pressing the fire in. Off (quick bite): a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but the flame is harder to catch.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The fire fang reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets that are not already burning rank first, so the lighting chance is not wasted; off: all targets rank the same.
